user.title: Volume Small Step
user.description: Adds `volume_up_small` and `volume_down_small` actions to all media_player entities. No configuration needed.

abort.already_configured: Volume Small Step is already configured.

volume_up_small.name: Volume up (small step)
volume_up_small.description: Increases the volume by a small step (default 0.02, i.e. 2 points).

volume_down_small.name: Volume down (small step)
volume_down_small.description: Decreases the volume by a small step (default 0.02, i.e. 2 points).
